evidence.producer: PROVISIONAL: src/target/source_policy/source_info.h and language_semantics.c define per-invocation, copy-by-value C/GNU language type policy (plain char, wchar, source builtin eligibility) separately from immutable machine target registration; data_layout_source.c owns C-record/array/field placement using target machine DataLayout, including packed and zero-width-bitfield alignment fences.
consumers: src/compiler/c_lower/core_type_import.c consumes the source type/layout oracle exactly at C→Core ingress to snapshot independent CoreType records, field offsets and nominal identities, rather than reconstructing C record types in Target machine code

src/target/target_info.h and data_layout.h define machine capabilities, fixed-register recognizers, pointer/float/vector storage and variadic transport distinct from language declaration acceptance and physical function ABI

src/target/common/core_function_plan.c verifies sealed Core and prepares one immutable function facts, calls index, object-storage plan, reachable blocks and value-use counts for a bounded callback lifetime
src/target/common/core_function_facts.c performs one Core instruction fact scan; core_call_index.c stores checked compact call views, with borrowed prepared index or owned standalone fallback
src/target/common/program_visit.c owns function/global visitation and destroys each temporary plan after target callback; src/target/backend.c binds only a registered backend to its canonical target

src/target/common/direct_lp64_abi.h and direct_function_emit.h encode shared A64/Loong orchestration parameterized by mandatory ISA-owned ABI policy, physical frame, machine instruction selection and preflight; src/target/common/lp64_aggregate.c classifies snapshots but is NOT a universal ABI classifier
evidence.functional_path: C06 PROVISIONAL responsibility chain: registered canonical machine TargetInfo + per-invocation SourceInfo options -> C nominal/object layout source-policy oracle -> CoreType/Module snapshot at compiler ingress -> sealed Core function/Module ownership -> common per-function validation, factual analysis, CALL/object/reachability plan, plan lifetime bounded by visitor -> ISA-provided ABI policy, physical frame/stack/GPR/FPR and machine selector -> typed MachineIR preflight -> target emitter. Shared LP64 orchestration is only legitimate when target-specific ABI policy and ISA callbacks remain distinct. A declaration accepted by C front-end does not imply code generation or ABI availability.
limitations: UNTRUSTED C06 MAPPING_PROPOSED ONLY; more Core/Target-common source and runtime regressions are required before any ownership chain is certified.
Shared C DataLayout is a source-language oracle, not machine frame allocation, ABI argument placement, or an instruction selector; target-specific ABI remains the machine owner.
Per-invocation SourceInfo must never be shallow-copied without rebinding internal integer_model pointer; examine all actual TargetInvocation call/assignment sites before claiming a defect.
LP64 shared emitter only covers targets whose ABI policy passes checks; AArch64 homogeneous aggregates, LoongArch LP64S and float, x86 SysV/Win64 and RV32 ILP32 are distinct contracts.
Validate packed/bitfield placement vs compiler Core type ingress using independent GNU oracles; only actual counterexamples can promote defects.
